heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny, with some clouds arriving late in the St. Lawrence Valley, with a chance of a shower.  Warmer.  Highs ranging through the 60s.  Light winds, becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy south.  Becoming mostly cloudy north, with a good chance of showers through Quebec, and scattered south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2, and dry south.  Breezy and mild.  Lows in the 40s to low 50s.  Winds south to southwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Becoming mostly sunny south, mixing with afternoon clouds. Some breaks of morning sun north, more afternoon clouds, with a few localized showers over the higher terrain.  Breezy and cooler.  Highs in the low to mid 50s north.  Still mild south, 60 to 65.  Winds becoming west to northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.
